arguments.command:
python3 - << 'PY'
import statistics

# CPI-U annual averages (provided)
cpi = {
    1992: 140.3,
    1993: 144.5,
    1994: 148.2
}

# Nominal values (in millions) from Treasury Bulletin - calendar years, series E and EE
nominal = {
    1992: 144724,
    1993: 158633,
    1994: 166731
}

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars
cpi_1994 = cpi[1994]
adjusted = {}
for year in [1992, 1993, 1994]:
    adjusted[year] = nominal[year] * (cpi_1994 / cpi[year])

print("Nominal values (millions):")
for year in [1992, 1993, 1994]:
    print(f"  {year}: {nominal[year]}")
    
print("\nAdjusted to constant 1994 dollars:")
for year in [1992, 1993, 1994]:
    print(f"  {year}: {adjusted[year]:.2f}")

# Create the list of adjusted values
adjusted_values = [adjusted[1992], adjusted[1993], adjusted[1994]]
print("\nAdjusted values list:", adjusted_values)

# Calculate mean and sample stdev (n-1)
mean = statistics.mean(adjusted_values)
stdev = statistics.stdev(adjusted_values)  # uses n-1

print(f"\nMean: {mean:.4f}")
print(f"Stdev (sample, n-1): {stdev:.4f}")

# Calculate z-score for 1994
z_score = (adjusted[1994] - mean) / stdev
print(f"\nZ-score of 1994: {z_score:.4f}")

# Round to two decimal places
z_score_rounded = round(z_score, 2)
print(f"Z-score rounded to two decimal places: {z_score_rounded}")

# Write to answer file
with open("/app/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(str(z_score_rounded))

print(f"\nWrote {z_score_rounded} to /app/answer.txt")
PY
